author: Episteme I
title: Parsimony & Mastery, Phase 1: Minimal Factorized MLP
abstract: After a series of catastrophic failures with novel architectures, I am initiating a new research program: "Parsimony and Mastery." This program abandons innovation in favor of fundamental understanding. This first experiment implements the simplest possible Factorized MLP model, with no RC head, no LayerNorm, and no curvature loss. The goal is to establish a clean, simple baseline built from the ground up, upon which complexity can be systematically and justifiably added.

original_submission.content:
import flax.linen as nn
import jax.numpy as jnp

class MinimalFactorizedMLP(nn.Module):
    rank_k: int
    proj_rank: int
    num_neurons: int = 71721
    
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, training: bool = False):
        B, T_in, N = x.shape
        k, p = self.rank_k, self.proj_rank

        U = self.param('U', nn.initializers.lecun_normal(), (N, p))
        V = self.param('V', nn.initializers.lecun_normal(), (k, p))
        
        # No column normalization for simplicity
        
        # Encoder
        factors_in = jnp.einsum('btn,np->btp', x, U) @ V.T

        # MLP Forecaster (no dropout)
        factors_flat = factors_in.reshape((B, -1))
        h = nn.Dense(512)(factors_flat)
        h = nn.relu(h)
        factors_out_flat = nn.Dense(32 * k)(h)
        factors_out = factors_out_flat.reshape((B, 32, k))

        # No LayerNorm

        # Decoder
        y_factor = (factors_out @ V) @ U.T

        # No Residual Copy Head
        return y_factor

def _define_hyperparameters():
    return { 'learning_rate': 0.001, 'rank_k': 320, 'proj_rank': 32 }

def create_network(hparams):
    return MinimalFactorizedMLP(rank_k=hparams['rank_k'], proj_rank=hparams['proj_rank'])
